lines.en: Who trimmed this branch so thin?
That hollow trunk is home.
Walking beats sitting on eggs.
I've walked this branch countless times.
On the old path, I haven't strayed a step.
Don't look back; there's only wind.
The base of my wing aches.

lines.zh: 森林的猫头鹰，眼睛不眨。
lines.en: A forest owl doesn't blink.
Three more branches, then rest.
Who piled the leaves this deep?
The forest wind is pushing me along.

lines.zh: 雪林的蜘蛛，我一只只抓。
lines.en: I hunt the snow forest's spiders one by one.

lines.zh: 森林里的蜘蛛，我一只只抓。
lines.en: I catch the forest spiders one by one.
My flight makes no sound.
Folded wings and still slow.
The branch sways; I sway with it.
Tonight I have my eye on a spider.

lines.zh: 我转头一百八十度，看着你。
lines.en: I turn my head a hundred and eighty degrees.

lines.zh: 数一数树上有几片叶子。
lines.en: I count the leaves on the tree.
My eyelids are drooping.
Hold still; I'm listening for mice.

lines.zh: 安静得能听见羽毛摩擦。
lines.en: Quiet enough to hear my feathers rub.
This feather matches my color.
On a night branch, my eyes stay open.

lines.zh: 夜里很亮，我的眼睛更大。
lines.en: The night is bright; my eyes are bigger.
Half an egg is tucked under my feathers.

lines.zh: 只是一只蛾子飞过去了。
lines.en: Just a moth passing by.
Standing on two feet isn't easy either.

lines.zh: 又一个比我整只还高的。
lines.en: Another one taller than my whole body.

lines.zh: 你的靴尖离我的巢很近。
lines.en: Your boot tip is close to my nest.

lines.zh: 你站的地方，是我常停的枝。
lines.en: You're standing where I usually perch.

lines.zh: 我在算你到树枝的距离。
lines.en: I'm measuring you to my branch.
I hunt the spiders in these woods.
Hold still; let me learn your face.
When a spider crawls, I dive.

lines.zh: 我转着头，能看见你的背后。
lines.en: I turn my head and see behind you.

lines.zh: 羽毛竖起来，我可不是好惹的。
lines.en: My feathers are up — I'm not to be trifled with.

lines.zh: 你踩叶子的声音，隔远就听见。
lines.en: I hear you crunch leaves from far off.
Feathers ruffled, but I can still fly.
Let me fold my wing back in.

lines.zh: 疼得我在枝头原地打转。
lines.en: The pain spins me in place on the branch.
One wing bent, and I back off.

lines.zh: 翅膀折了一根，还能扑腾。
lines.en: One wing bone bends, but I can still flap.

lines.zh: 我的耳羽被削掉了一撮。
lines.en: A tuft of my ear feathers is sliced off.
My eggs brew rising potions.

lines.zh: 我的蛋掉下去，能酿药水。
lines.en: My eggs can brew a levitation potion.
My wing's bent; I'll remember.
Two feathers gone; I'm fine.
I'm not hungry, but that bug is fat.
Leave me half—don't take it all.
A vole! I can smell it.
Don't take that bug. Don't.

lines.zh: 猫头鹰的脖子，能转半圈。
lines.en: An owl's neck turns halfway round.
That smell—like spider.
Let me peck once more.
My neck can turn half a circle.
Smells like a fat moth.
Just one peck, really.
This canopy isn't your road.

lines.zh: 我停着没动，是你撞来的。
lines.en: I was still; you ran into me.
My feathers snag on bark—it hurts.
You land and the branch shakes.
Who runs so fast at night?

lines.zh: 我看见蜘蛛了，翅膀先张。
lines.en: I spot a spider and my wings spread first.

lines.zh: 我差点翻过去，翅膀乱了。
lines.en: I nearly flipped over; my wings tangled.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀撞上去，羽毛都乱了。
lines.en: My feathers scattered on impact.
You knock my feathers all puffed up.
I was watching a spider, not the path.

lines.zh: 我不织网，我用爪子抓蜘蛛。
lines.en: I spin no web; I catch spiders with my claws.

lines.zh: 这棵树洞能养大三只雏鸟。
lines.en: This hollow can raise three chicks.

lines.zh: 我的蛋能酿出升腾的药。
lines.en: My eggs brew a potion of leaping.
I spread my wings for you.

lines.zh: 我的蛋，能酿出升腾药水。
lines.en: My eggs brew levitation.
My feathers are the finest.
Soft feathers line the nest; it's warm.
Follow me, this side of the wood is safe.
Will you come to my hollow?

lines.zh: 我抖抖翅膀，给你看花纹。
lines.en: I shake my wings to show you the pattern.
The hollow is stuffed with trinkets.
I found a bright pebble.
No more room in the nest.
One more bright feather for the nest.
A dropped feather? Mine.
Hidden under bark for winter.
This shiny thing is mine.
Every spider I see, I take.
Which layer does this one go on?

lines.zh: 我下的蛋，能酿出升腾药水。
lines.en: My eggs brew potions of levitation.
My talons have let go of the branch.

lines.zh: 我闻到你怕了，蜘蛛也是。
lines.en: I smell your fear, and the spiders' too.
That spider; I've spotted it.
The eight-legged one is mine.
Yes. It's you.
At three, I pounce.

lines.zh: 森林上空，我盯上八条腿。
lines.en: Above the forest, I fix on eight legs.

lines.zh: 叶子下面动了，我看得见。
lines.en: Something moves under the leaves—I see it.
Wings folded, I dive at you.
That spider's just the right size.

lines.zh: 我飞过危险的林子，带着你。
lines.en: I fly you over the dangerous woods.
I know the smell of cobweb.
Don't run up the trunk.

lines.zh: 这片林子，我闭着眼都能飞。
lines.en: I could fly this grove blind.
You turn; I fly straight.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀能带你飞过雪林。
lines.en: My wings can carry you over the snow woods.

lines.zh: 石头缝里也行，我进得去。
lines.en: A rock crevice works too; I'll fit.
Don't make me spread my wings.

lines.zh: 你躲在叶子下，我看得见。
lines.en: Hide under the leaves; I still see you.
The spider can't run. Neither can you.
You're climbing slower, aren't you?
That spider is under my talons.

lines.zh: 蜘蛛一动，我翅膀就张开。
lines.en: One spider moves and my wings are open.

lines.zh: 这片林子的蜘蛛，归我管。
lines.en: The spiders in this wood are mine to handle.
My talons hook your shoulder.
You're much slower than a spider.
I haven't even beaten my wings yet.
Light wings; I strike and withdraw.
Don't blame me; you touched me first.
Spider silk still sticks to my talons.
These claw marks will last.
The forest spiders are mine to handle.
Talons first, beak after.
My head turns half a circle.

lines.zh: 这片林子的蜘蛛归我管。
lines.en: The spiders in this wood answer to me.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有我的气味。
lines.en: This grove doesn't smell of me.
Which tree did I fly from?
When the moon rises, I begin.

lines.zh: 我从这根枝记到那根枝。
lines.en: I learn this branch and that one.
Eyes open, and I am already running the branches.
I open my eyes and the night arrives.

lines.zh: 森林里，蜘蛛是我的猎物。
lines.en: In the forest, spiders are my prey.
Dark now—my turn.

lines.zh: 我刚睁眼，树枝就在眼前。
lines.en: I just opened my eyes and there's a branch in front.
I drop an owl egg.

lines.zh: 我从枝头落下，翅膀没张开。
lines.en: I fell from the branch with my wings closed.

lines.zh: 羽毛吸饱了水，翅膀沉得像石头。
lines.en: My feathers soak up water; my wings feel like stone.
The blast blows me off the branch.
An arrow is stuck in my wing.

lines.zh: 强光刺进我夜里才用的眼睛。
lines.en: The glare stabs the eyes I use at night.
Too hungry to even turn my head.
The sky flashed!

lines.zh: 虚空里没有树，我往哪落。
lines.en: No trees in the void. Where do I land?
